description: Check one resume bullet with the fixed rules (score, verdict, fixes) and suggest up to three stronger rewrites that keep every fact as given. Where a number would help, the rewrite leaves a slot such as [X%] for the user to fill. Part of the answer is drafted by an AI model (Gemma 4, with Llama 3.3 70B as a backup, on Cloudflare Workers AI) behind ATSPrep's guard, which drops any figure, name or tool the user's text doesn't contain. If the AI part is unavailable, the rule-based part still comes back and ai.message says why.

company.description: Optional. The employer this bullet sits under.

role.description: Optional. The job title this bullet sits under.

name: improve_bullet
title: Improve a resume bullet
